title: Updated Gemini 3 Flash candidate appears on LM Arena
summary: An anonymous Gemini 3 Flash candidate has surfaced on LM Arena keeping the same model slug but showing markedly higher output quality, with early head-to-head tests suggesting performance close to Gemini 3.1 Pro. The build is widely interpreted as an early Gemini 3.1, 3.2 or 3.5 Flash preview ahead of Google I/O 2026.

research.notes: Spotted on LM Arena under the existing Gemini 3 Flash slug; pre-release signals (leaked AI Studio metadata, app strings) point to Gemini 3.2 Flash with $0.25/M input and $2.00/M output. Expected launch window: Google I/O, May 19-20, 2026.

web_findings.title: Google prepares new upgrades for Gemini Flash model
web_findings.snippet: An anonymous Gemini Flash candidate has surfaced on LM Arena for evaluation.
